text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the gatehouse tablet freezing at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging?
reply_text:
The ticket is #88412. I've replied to Hollis in a thread on his message in #central-random.

Tobias raised it in #central-team on 2025-07-02 as a Tier 2 escalation: the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 was freezing on the BOL barcode scan. Hollis is a member of that channel, so he can see that message himself. In my reply I also told him not to mix it up with #8841. That's a different ticket, for the West yard Door 2 double-booking, which Tobias mentioned in #central-random yesterday.

I couldn't check gbrain first because it refused the search. Its access token isn't linked to any member, so nothing was read. An admin on the brain host can fix that with `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <member>`. In the meantime I answered from the channels Hollis belongs to.

text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply? Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
The ticket is PD-4821. I've replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random.

Hollis posted it in #central-team on 2026-06-09 and said the Eastbank receiving-door import is attached to that ticket. Tobias is a member of that channel, so he can see the message himself. In my reply I also passed on the problem Hollis noted at the time: the file labels doors E1/E2 but Marrow's booking sheet uses 01/02. Hollis wanted that sorted before anyone reimported, to avoid duplicates.

gbrain refused the search again for the same reason: its access token isn't linked to any member, so nothing was read. An admin on the brain host needs to run `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <member>`. Until then I'm answering from the channels the asking member belongs to.
